title: EZoom
description: Add the C to Simple Zoom In The Your World
body:
# EZoom

A lightweight, smooth, and configurable zoom mod for **Fabric 1.21.1**.

EZoom provides a clean OptiFine-style zoom experience with smooth animations, adjustable zoom levels, automatic mouse sensitivity scaling, and an optional HUD hiding feature.

## Features

* 🔍 Smooth hold-to-zoom system
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized
* 🎮 Adjustable zoom level
* 🖱️ Automatic mouse sensitivity scaling while zoomed
* 👁️ Optional HUD hiding during zoom
* ⚙️ In-game configuration support
* 🧩 Fully compatible with Fabric
* 🚀 Designed for maximum performance

## Controls

**Default Zoom Key:** `C`

The key can be changed in Minecraft's Controls menu.

## Requirements

This mod requires the following dependencies:

* Fabric API
* Cloth Config API
* Mod Menu

Make sure all required dependencies are installed before launching the game. Cloth Config provides the configuration screen, while Mod Menu allows easy access to the mod settings.

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.21.1**
* Fabric Loader

## Compatibility

Works with most Fabric client-side mods, including optimization mods such as Sodium and Iris.

## License

Feel free to include this mod in modpacks. Please do not redistribute modified versions without permission.

If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for new features, feel free to leave a comment or open an issue.
